title: Project history and source reconciliation
text: The repository contains multiple generations: the early single-plate image-analysis idea, the three-zone enclosure, the expanded technical manual, the APEX XR flagship dossier and the later multi-plate gantry and public-health discussions. They should remain dated alternatives rather than being silently combined into one manufactured device. [S21][S22][S27][S28]

The supplied enclosure drawings show different component placements and title-block details. Dimensions, screen size, equipment labels, dates and engineer names embedded in the images have not been verified as fabrication specifications or authorship records.

The full original dossier remains available. New notes clarify maturity and add source provenance. Similar filenames are not sufficient evidence of duplication, and a PDF companion is not necessarily redundant with its editable source.
